GEOGPT · GSA SHORT COURSE · 150 MINUTES

GeoGPT for geoscience research

Investigate three questions in paleontology, geophysics and natural hazards. Use supplied observations, short source summaries and GeoGPT to develop an interpretation you can explain.

Follow the numbered prompts. No extra technical answers are required between them. References are optional further reading; the lesson supplies the background you need. Use each step’s help if GeoGPT asks an unexpected question.

Before class: create your international account and check Research access. Allow 10–15 minutes before the 150-minute course; email/access delays are additional.

EXERCISE 1 · 45 MIN

Fossil identification

Compare one fossil’s overall shape with its internal CT sections using supplied Treatise summaries. Three prompts; no statistical settings or required paper reading.

EXERCISE 2 · 45 MIN

Seismic wedge

Compare a known sand wedge with its calculated echoes. Supplied settings, six small steps, and no upload requirement.

EXERCISE 3 · SIMPLE MAP WORKFLOW

Landslide prediction

Upload terrain, matching USGS shaking and the supplied model. Make and explain a potential-landslide map.
